testCases.title: Display Required Fields in Contact Form
expectedResults: The fields for first name, last name, email, subject, and message are displayed in the contact form.

testCases.title: Subject Dropdown Options
steps: Open the subject dropdown in the contact form.
expectedResults: All specified options are included in the subject dropdown.

testCases.title: Validation Error for Message Length
steps: Enter valid first name, last name, email, subject.
Enter a message with fewer than 50 characters.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown indicating that the message must be at least 50 characters.

testCases.title: Successful Submission Displays Confirmation Message
steps: Enter valid first name, last name, email, subject, and message.
